summary: Lloyds Banking Group plc filed a Form 6-K on April 29, 2026, reporting its unaudited consolidated results for the three months ended March 31, 2026. The filing is a routine quarterly earnings report by a foreign private issuer, incorporated by reference into its registration statement. No special situation such as an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC transaction, or management change is present. The filing contains forward-looking statements subject to risks and uncertainties but does not announce any corporate event or transaction.
